label: In Another World with My Companions: B

lines.text: *Pop pop*
*Pop pop*
*Boom*!
Game Over

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Darn... this isn't easy.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Not easy? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: B-Boss?!

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: When did you get here?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You didn't pick up the phone, so I decided to stop by in person.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I've been here for precisely...

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Twelve minutes and five seconds.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: You called?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I had no idea.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Have you been playing games all day again?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I wish you could at least keep your room tidy.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What game were you playing this time?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Oh... it's called Combat Ace.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: You control a fighter jet and you've got to shoot down enemy planes.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Using...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: tactics, that is.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Sounds like a wonderful game.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: But I seem to recall you playing Iron Punch not so long ago.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'm past that now.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: After mastering all 763 levels with every character, there was nothing left to do.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: 763 levels? That many?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: At any rate, why aren't you playing with Guillotine?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: She seems obsessed with games as of late.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Oh, Guillotine?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Black Rose, I have a favor to ask of you.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I've been undergoing virtual simulation training to make my movements more efficient, and was wondering if you would...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'll pass.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Then what about...

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Pass.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Pass.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I didn't even say anything!

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Pass.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Okay, fine. I'll be straight with you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I've started playing a game called Final Quest Online,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: but I'm having a tough time trying to level up.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Whenever I'm with other players, all I end up doing is drag—

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Er... well... things just don't go so well, that's all.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Who would dare speak to you that way?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Anyway, I was wondering if you could grant me access to Black Rose's breadth of knowledge?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I happened to overhear that your avatar, Black Rose,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: is a legendary figure in Final Quest Online.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: There's only one boss raid which you haven't cleared.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The rest you've managed to complete solo.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: A remarkable achievement truly befitting one who bears the moniker of Lone Master of Kotodama.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: ... All right, let me ask you something first.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: What is your profession, exactly?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: My profession?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I am an adventurer, tasked with protecting Eronia.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: All sorts of guilds have tried to butter me up with job offers,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: but I could see plain as day that they only wanted to exploit my fame as a hero.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Oh... okay.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: So then!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Would you join my party for an adventure?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I want to enter the first dungeon, but no one will join me.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Or rather, no one is good enough for me.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Guillotine, I'm going to give you an honest answer.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: And I will give an honest reaction.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'm not sure what compelled you to pick up gaming all of a sudden,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: but adventures are something you only go on with those whom you resonate with on a deep emotional level.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Really. You're going to have to look for someone else other than me.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Someone who is a good match for you.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Besides, I've moved past joining parties with other players.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: It seems to me that she simply picked it up out of curiosity.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I'm sure she'll tire of it soon enough.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Curiosity, you say?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I don't think that's the reason she started.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: But I suppose it's not my place to comment.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Are you done talking? If you are, I'd like to play one more round.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Maiden.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: After how badly you bungled your last mission, I placed you on indefinite suspension.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I realize I gave you permission to spend your time in the dorm as you saw fit,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: but I hoped that you wouldn't slack off as much as you have.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: So have you changed your mind?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: No. My thoughts remain the same.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Very well, then. This will be your final task.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Come with me.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Sorry for taking so long. It took a while to drag Maiden over here.
It's okay. I didn't wait long.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: And I had fun having some alone time with Sweetie, besides.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: All right,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: now that everyone's arrived, it's high time I explain why I've gathered you all here.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: 12 hours ago, during a newly created simulation,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Guillotine used an ocular device without authorization.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If we don't receive retroactive approval from the Central Government within 36 hours, Guillotine's brain will be subject to termination.
Can't we get approval straight away?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I'm afraid not.
Why?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Guillotine hasn't been proven to be an Irregular yet.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Without tangible proof such as that, the Central Government won't be willing to issue retroactive approval.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Our mission is simple.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Go into the simulation, assess Guillotine's condition,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: and leave the simulation just as we came.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If it's determined that Guillotine has become an Irregular,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: you're authorized to terminate her as soon as you exit the simulation.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If Guillotine becomes an Irregular,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: you are the only Nikke who can do what must be done.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If that situation comes, you will have to kill Guillotine yourself.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Will you be able to do that, Maiden?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: As a member of the Extrinsic Squad, it is my duty to remain objective and distinguish between professional and personal affairs.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I must keep my composure and do what must be done for the sake of the Ark.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I will follow the orders that are given to me.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, you're to assist Maiden in determining

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: whether Guillotine has become an Irregular or not.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: The final judgment call will be yours to make.
Me? Why not you?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: The Central Government has decided that I am incapable of maintaining objectivity throughout this case.
... I understand.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Moving on.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Einkk, please go over the simulation you've created.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Alrighty then.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: There I was one day in the simulation room,

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: bored out of my gourd, when it came to me.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: By using the data recorded in NIMPH, I could create a simulation on a planetary scale.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: At the same time, I could set whatever people or objects the user feared most as the primary antagonist.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: I felt it would make for an incredibly immersive and enjoyable gaming experience,

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: so I submitted the idea,

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: and it got approved.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: And that is how Simulation MK-II was born.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Guillotine was in the middle of quality testing when this incident occurred.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: So this simulation that we're about to enter

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: is based on the data recorded in Guillotine's NIMPH?

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Correct. I see you were paying attention.
Sorry, but I'm not quite following.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: You'll understand soon enough once you enter the simulation.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: How do we get out of the simulation?

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: The same as any game.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Either defeat the final boss,

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: or open the system window and end the simulation.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Oh... that was simpler than I thought it'd be.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Naturally.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Unfortunately, Guillotine hasn't been able to exit the simulation herself.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Anyway, do you see that over there?

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: You can use that machine to enter the simulation.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Be careful not to take it off too suddenly, as that could have some damaging effects on your brain.
Is there anything else we should be aware of?

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Let me think...

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Ah, yes. Time in the simulation passes twice as fast as in reality.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: In other words,

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: one day in the simulation is equal to 12 real-world hours.
Got it. So if we have 36 hours to get the Central Government's approval,
that means we have a total of three days in the simulation.
There's no time to waste, so let's get a move on, Maiden.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: All right, but I'm already worried what kind of world is waiting for us inside...

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Now, now, quit your bellyaching.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Have you got your devices on?

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: If you're ready,

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: I'll start.

lines.speaker: einkk
lines.text: Simulation. Start.
*Flash*
